description: Read a PDF and return its text as markdown (or plain text). Accepts a public URL, base64 bytes, or a local file path. Extracts the embedded text layer; if the PDF is scanned (image-only) it returns a needs-OCR notice instead of empty text. The canonical way for an AI agent to ingest a document's contents.

maxPages.description: Cap the number of pages extracted.

source.description: The PDF to read. Provide exactly one of: url, base64, or path.

path.description: Absolute local file path to read (when type is 'path').

type.description: Where the PDF is: 'url' a public URL, 'base64' inline PDF bytes, 'path' a local file.

url.description: Public URL of the PDF to read. Private addresses are blocked.

name: read_pdf
title: Read PDF
